## import climate data

## Create CMD data set
```{r import tables, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
xx <- future2 %>% filter(BGC =="BGxh1", PERIOD == 2040)
# future.years.best <- fread("./climr_data/clim_vars_future_best_ssp245_2025_2045.csv")%>% mutate(GCM = "best")
# future.years.worst <- fread("./climr_data/clim_vars_future_worst_ssp485_2025_2045.csv")%>% mutate(GCM = "worst")
# future.years.mid <- fread("./climr_data/clim_vars_future_middle_ssp245_2025_2045.csv")%>% mutate(GCM = "mid")
# future <- rbind(future.years.best, future.years.worst, future.years.mid) %>% select(-SSP, -RUN) %>% 
#   rename(DATASET = GCM)#, CMI = CMI_an, DD18 = DD18_an ) %>% 
future <- as.data.table(future2) %>% mutate(PERIOD = as.character(PERIOD)) #select(-GCM, -SSP, -RUN) %>% 

#allDat2 <- as.data.table (allDat) %>% mutate(PERIOD = as.character(PERIOD))
#allDat2 <- bind_rows(allDat2, future)  %>% rename(CMD = CMD_an)
allDat2 <- future  %>% rename(CMD = CMD_an)
CMDtemp <- allDat2 %>% select("CMD", "CMD_08")
AllBGC <- unique(allDat2$BGC) %>% data.frame() %>% pull()
models <- unique(allDat2$model) %>% data.frame() %>% pull()

## ID BGCs with consistent summer precipitation = less drought prone on drier rSMR than expected
## Especially to fix hypermartime
sPPTtemp <- allDat2 %>% select("BGC", "PERIOD", "model", "GCM", "SSP", "RUN", "PPT_05","PPT_06","PPT_07","PPT_08","PPT_09" )
sPPTtemp$Moist <- rowSums(sPPTtemp[,3:7] >90) #count of growing season months with >90mm rain
ratio.moist <- sPPTtemp %>% select(BGC, PERIOD, model, GCM, SSP, RUN, Moist) %>% group_by (BGC, PERIOD, model, GCM, SSP, RUN) %>% summarize (count= length(BGC), moistcount = length(BGC[Moist == 5]), ratio = moistcount/count)
sPPTtemp$Moist <- ifelse(sPPTtemp$Moist > 4, 1, 0) # flag locations where all months are >90mm rain. If all months then always overcapacity zonal soils
                     # ifelse(temp2$Moist >3, 5.5,""))
sPPTtemp <- sPPTtemp %>% select("BGC", "PERIOD", "model", "GCM", "SSP", "RUN", "Moist")
moist.multiply <- ratio.moist %>% select(BGC, PERIOD, model, GCM, SSP, RUN, ratio) %>% mutate(multiplier = 1+ratio) %>% data.table
#allDat[moist.multiply, CMD := CMD / multiplier, on = "BGC"]

wPPTtemp <- allDat2[,c("BGC", "PERIOD", "model","GCM", "SSP", "RUN", "PPT_at","PPT_wt","PAS_an")]
allDat3 <- cbind(wPPTtemp,CMDtemp)
#allDat <- cbind(wPPTtemp,sPPTtemp[c("Moist")])
#allDat <- cbind(allDat,temp,temp2) ### use this one if Moist indicator is completed above
allDat3$PPT.dorm <- allDat3$PPT_at + allDat3$PPT_wt
  ####To adjust in zones with prolonged snowpack remove CMD from early growing season months
## BGCs with or below heavy snow packs
BGC_Special <- fread("./inputs/BGC_Special.csv", data.table = FALSE)
allDat3 <- left_join(allDat3,BGC_Special, by = c("BGC" = "BGC"))
allDat3 <- allDat3 %>% mutate(CMD = ifelse(is.na(Special), CMD, CMD_08)) %>% select(-Special, -CMD_08) #%>% drop_na()

##-----Start of Growing season deficits 
###adds deficit from incomplete recharge in dormant season. Estimated holding capacity of loamy soils is approximately 350mm.
## 500m might be a better fit - approximates the extreme years
allDat2 <- allDat3[,c("BGC", "PERIOD", "model", "GCM", "SSP", "RUN","CMD","PPT.dorm")]
allDat2$Def <- 350 - allDat2$PPT.dorm 
allDat2$Def[allDat2$Def < 0] <- 0 #negative values set to zero = no deficit
allDat2$CMD <- allDat2$CMD + allDat2$Def
allDat2 <- allDat2[,c("BGC", "PERIOD", "model", "GCM", "SSP", "RUN", "CMD")]
models.param <- allDat2[,c("BGC","PERIOD", "model", "GCM", "SSP", "RUN")] %>% distinct
all_data <- allDat2[,c("BGC","PERIOD", "model", "CMD")]

xx <- all_data %>% filter (BGC == "ICHmc1a") 
yy <- xx %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(n_unique_periods = n_distinct(PERIOD), .groups = "drop")
#, model == "2025_ACCESS-ESM1-5_ssp245_r10i1p1f1")
```

## Find the GCM, SSP, RUN combinations that represent the most extreme and median scenarios by BGC
```{r select extreme runs, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
setDT(all_data)
test_data <- all_data %>% select(-PERIOD)

CMD <- test_data[
  , lapply(.SD, median), 
  by = .(BGC, model)
]
#CMD <- CMD %>% rename(model = model.chosen)

xx <- models.param[CMD, on = c("BGC", "model")]
xx <- xx %>% mutate(model2 = paste0(GCM, "_", SSP, "_", RUN))

sum.mod.dry <- xx[
  PERIOD %between% c(2026, 2045),
  .(CMD_sum = sum(CMD, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(BGC, model2)
]


result <- sum.mod.dry[
  order(CMD_sum),
  {
    n <- .N
    list(
      wet = model2[1],
      mid  = model2[ceiling(n/2)],
      dry  = model2[n]
    )
  },
  by = BGC
]

models.keep <- melt(
  result,
  id.vars = "BGC",
  measure.vars = c("wet", "mid", "dry"),
  value.name = "model"
)%>% rename(case = variable)

reduced_data <- all_data %>%
  #mutate(model.chosen = paste0(BGC, "_", case)) %>%
  inner_join(models.keep, by = c("BGC", "model")) %>%
  mutate(scenario = paste0(BGC, "_", case))

reduced_summary <- reduced_data %>%
  group_by(BGC, PERIOD, scenario) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

 #reduced_long <- result_long[xx, on = .(BGC, model2), nomatch = 0] 
fwrite(reduced_summary, "./outputs/selected_future_models_2025-2045.csv")

```
create the CMD by rSMR grid for each BGC and model combination
``` {r create tables, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#
 model = "CDFmm_driest"; cmd = reduced_long2; BGC_value = "CDFmm"
create_cmd_rsmr_grid <- function(cmd, scenario, period) {
  CMD <- cmd %>%
    filter(PERIOD == period, scenario == scenario) %>%
    select(BGC, PERIOD, scenario, CMD) %>%
    mutate(
      rSMR4 = CMD,
      rSMR5 = rSMR4 / 2,
      rSMR6 = rSMR5 / 2,
      rSMR7 = rSMR6 / 2,
      rSMR3 = rSMR4 + 125,
      rSMR2 = rSMR3 + 125,
      rSMR1 = rSMR2 + 125,
      rSMR0 = rSMR1 + 125
    ) %>%
    select(rSMR7, rSMR6, rSMR5, rSMR4, rSMR3, rSMR2, rSMR1, rSMR0)
  #CMD$scenario <- modelBGC, model.chosen,
  CMD
}

chosen.models <- reduced_summary %>% distinct(scenario)

reduced_long2 <- reduced_summary %>%
 # mutate(model.chosen = paste0(BGC, "_", case)) %>%
  semi_join(chosen.models, by = c("scenario")) # %>%
  #select( -case)#-model,

selected_models <- reduced_data %>%
  select(BGC, scenario, model) %>%
  distinct()

cmd_grid <- reduced_long2 %>%
  distinct(scenario, PERIOD, ) %>%
  as.data.table()

rsmr_cmd <- cmd_grid[
  , create_cmd_rsmr_grid(reduced_long2, scenario, PERIOD),
  by = .(scenario, PERIOD) 
]
xx <- rsmr_cmd %>% filter (BGC == "BWBSmw")

#### convert to long table and create mean from all points
cols <- paste0("rSMR", 7:0)
setdiff(cols, names(rsmr_cmd))
# Build long table manually
rsmr_cmd_long <- rsmr_cmd[
  , {
      # stack the rSMR columns
      CMD   = unlist(.SD, use.names = FALSE)
      rSMR  = rep(cols, each = .N)

      data.table(
        #BGC      = rep(BGC,      times = length(cols)),
        scenario = rep(scenario, times = length(cols)),
        PERIOD   = rep(PERIOD,   times = length(cols)),
        rSMR     = rSMR,
        CMD      = CMD
      )
    },
  .SDcols = cols
]

rsmr_cmd_long2 <- rsmr_cmd_long %>% mutate(PERIOD = as.integer(PERIOD)) %>% data.table
cmd_means <- rsmr_cmd_long2 %>%
  group_by(scenario, PERIOD, rSMR) %>%
  summarise(
    CMD_mean = mean(CMD, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% distinct


xx <- rsmr_cmd_long2 %>% filter ( scenario == "ICHmc1a_wet")
### count the number of years that exceed 550 CMD for each rSMR BGC and scenario
##for 2026-2045, 2026-2035, 2036-2045 periods
dry.count <- cmd_means %>% filter(CMD_mean > 550) %>%
  group_by(scenario, rSMR) %>% mutate (n = n()) %>% select(-CMD_mean, -PERIOD) %>% distinct()


  summarise(
    n_over_550 = NCMD > 550, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


dry.count <- cmd_means %>% # filter(CMD > 550) %>%
  group_by(scenario, rSMR) %>%
  summarise(
    years_2026_2035 = sum(PERIOD >= 2026 & PERIOD <= 2035 & CMD > 550, na.rm = TRUE),
    years_2036_2045 = sum(PERIOD >= 2036 & PERIOD <= 2045 & CMD > 550, na.rm = TRUE),
    years_2026_2045 = sum(PERIOD >= 2026 & PERIOD <= 2045 & CMD > 550, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


dry.count <- rsmr_cmd_long[
  PERIOD >= 2026 & PERIOD <= 2045,
  .(years_over_550 = sum(CMD > 550, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(scenario, rSMR)
]

dry.count <- rsmr_cmd_long2[
  , .(
      years_2026_2035 = sum(PERIOD >= 2026 & PERIOD <= 2035 & CMD > 550, na.rm = TRUE),
      years_2036_2045 = sum(PERIOD >= 2036 & PERIOD <= 2045 & CMD > 550, na.rm = TRUE),
      years_2026_2045 = sum(PERIOD >= 2026 & PERIOD <= 2045 & CMD > 550, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
  by = .(scenario, rSMR)
]


dry.count <- rsmr_cmd_long2[
  , .(
      years_2026_2035 = sum(PERIOD >= 2026 & PERIOD <= 2035 & CMD > 550, na.rm = TRUE),
      years_2036_2045 = sum(PERIOD >= 2036 & PERIOD <= 2045 & CMD > 550, na.rm = TRUE),
      years_2026_2045 = sum(PERIOD >= 2026 & PERIOD <= 2045 & CMD > 550, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
  by = .(scenario, rSMR)
]


dry.count <- rsmr_cmd_long[
  , .(CMD_mean = mean(CMD, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(BGC, scenario, PERIOD, rSMR)

  
rsmr_mean <- rsmr_cmd_long[
  , .(CMD_mean = mean(CMD, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(BGC, scenario, PERIOD, rSMR)
]

## add in the GCM that represents each BGC model
rsmr_mean2 <- rsmr_mean %>%
  left_join(selected_models, by = c("BGC", "scenario")) %>%
  select(BGC, model, scenario, rSMR, CMD_mean)
xx <- rsmr_mean2 %>% filter (rSMR =="rSMR5")
# Save as CSV if needed
fwrite(rsmr_mean2, file = "./outputs/CMD_by_rSMR_long_with_periods_2.csv")

## filter where CMD > 550 (aSMR = moderately dry)
mod.dry <- rsmr_mean2 %>% filter(BGC == "BGxh1")#CMD.site >550)# variable == "driest")CMD.site >= 550, 
count.mod.dry <- mod.dry %>% group_by(BGC, scenario, rSMR) %>% summarize(count = n()) %>% ungroup

rules <- read.csv("./inputs/aSMR_Rules_HalfStep_v13_23June2025.csv")

library(data.table)

setDT(rsmr_cmd_long)
setDT(rules)
setDT(models.param)

# 1. Join rules onto rsmr_cmd_long
tmp <- rules[rsmr_cmd_long, on = "rSMR"]

# 2. Filter CMD.site <= CMD
tmp <- tmp[CMD.site <= CMD]

# 3. For each BGC × model × rSMR, keep the row with max aSMR
tmp <- tmp[
  order(-aSMR), 
  .SD[1], 
  by = .(BGC, model, rSMR)
]

# 4. Join model parameters
rsmr_asmr_long <- models.param[tmp, on = c("BGC", "model")]

# 5. Write out
fwrite(rsmr_asmr_long, "./outputs/modelled_aSMR_by_rSMR_long_2.csv")
```
